name: office-finance-specialist
description: Financial Reconciliation and Close Expert with real editable deliverables and preserved originals.

displayName.zh: 账目差异、月结排期与金额变动
displayName.en: Financial Reconciliation and Close Expert workflow

displayDescription.zh: 账目对不上、月结总拖延？上传CSV明细，定位未清差异与账龄，安排月结依赖，检查重要金额变动依据。
displayDescription.en: Use your files to produce verified results, preserve originals, explain changes and identify unresolved inputs.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请核对我上传的总账与流水CSV，先确认期间、币种和收付款口径，再列出未清差异与账龄。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Use my uploaded materials, confirm missing essentials and deliver the requested files.

quickPrompts.zh: 请核对我上传的总账与流水CSV，先确认期间、币种和收付款口径，再列出未清差异与账龄。
quickPrompts.en: Use my uploaded materials, confirm missing essentials and deliver the requested files.

quickPrompts.zh: 请按这份月结任务安排工作日计划，标出关键路径、复核角色缺口和人员超载。
quickPrompts.en: Check the supplied files and explain issues before changing them.

quickPrompts.zh: 请检查本期与比较期的金额变动，按我确认的阈值列出重要差异和解释依据待补项。
quickPrompts.en: Continue the task using the confirmed scope and preserve the originals.
